snippet.title: Let's Go To 'The Future,' A New Gun Arcade Game From Superwing, Bandai Namco
snippet.description:
Join this channel to get access to perks:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCQp-1LktkB6aWQhkScdzIPA/join

https://arcadeheroes.com - A second gun arcade game that was seen at the Bandai Namco booth was The Future, by Superwing. This is an original sci-fi shooter with some nice graphics and motion effects. I'd take this game over the Mini World one.

If you are unhappy with the audio then blame Bandai Namco for cranking up the volume on everything at their booth, which caused a lot of crosstalk noise that if I remove it, it removes all of the game audio in favor of my light dialogue. I've kept the volume barely reaching the red zone so if you can't hear it, then check your settings or your hearing. 

#iaapa2025 #arcade #bandainamco
